title: Director, Systems Engineering
description:
Amogy is a clean tech energy company redefining how power is delivered. Our technology converts ammonia into hydrogen on demand, which makes ammonia a practical, carbon-free energy carrier for reliable power. That power is dispatchable, for sites where the grid is constrained, unreliable or insufficient, or where customers simply need clean power. As demand for clean power grows, Amogy is building the energy systems to deliver it cleanly, reliably and at scale.

  

**Job Summary**

We are hiring a Systems Engineering leader to own how Amogy's ammonia-to-power systems come together as a whole. An Amogy system combines chemical fuel processing, high-temperature thermal equipment, rotating power generation, fuel cell, electrical and power conversion, and controls. Your job is to make sure the system works as one, and that what the customer receives matches what we set out to build.

  

You will set up Amogy's Systems Engineering and technical program management from first principles: requirements, architecture, interfaces, integration, verification and validation, and the integrated schedule. You will be the technical lead for system-level tradeoffs and the person who keeps the discipline teams aligned. The role is hands-on, and you will own the system model and the program schedule.

  

We are hiring at the Director or Senior Manager level, depending on experience.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**System architecture and requirements**

* Own the system-level requirements, from customer and site needs through to subsystem and component specifications. Keep them traceable and under change control.
* Define and maintain the system architecture and interface across process, thermal, mechanical, electrical, controls and software.
